input.name: x
input.resize: OpenCV INTER_LINEAR, ceil(aspect_ratio*48), minimum padded width320, max width3200 in official PaddleX processor

original_contract.architecture: LCNetV4 backbone + EncoderWithLightSVTR neck + CTC inference head; auxiliary NRTR training head omitted from inference

wrapper_contract.prefix: multiply2; repeat grayscale channel3times; right pad to width>=320 with normalized zero
wrapper_contract.postfix: clamp probabilities to[1e-30,1]; natural log; transpose[1,0,2] to[T,N,C]

limitations: Small fixed physical-crop probe does not establish general language/font/layout coverage.
Original publisher training corpus is not enumerated here, so upstream benchmark contamination cannot be excluded.
The grayscale adapter discards color and differs from official preprocessing; numerical parity is tested between ORT and RTen for identical wrapper input.
No Korean, Hebrew, Arabic, Devanagari, Cyrillic dictionary entries found by Unicode-name category audit; Greek glyph presence does not establish Ancient Greek coverage.
Japanese ruby/vertical layout, MTG mana symbols, full-card detector and rare scripts need separate validation.
